name: Corner Bowl Poke
blurb: $1.25 off any large poke bowl, $1 off regular size.
details: Discount applies to any bowl size, any day of the week. Catering orders of $50 or more also qualify for 10% off — ask a manager for the catering menu.
redeem: Show your hospital ID badge at checkout.

name: Riverside Hospital Cafeteria
blurb: 20% off all cafeteria purchases, every shift.
details: Available to all hospital staff at any time the cafeteria is open, including nights and weekends. The discount is applied automatically at checkout.
redeem: Swipe your staff badge at the register.

name: FreshPrep Meal Co.
blurb: 10% off all online meal-prep orders.
details: Orders must be placed online by Thursday each week for Saturday pickup at the storefront. Discount does not apply to gift cards.
redeem: Enter code STAFF10 at online checkout.

name: PulseFit 24
blurb: No enrollment fee plus 10% off monthly dues.
details: Requires a 12-month membership agreement. Includes access to all nationwide PulseFit locations and one free fitness assessment.
redeem: Present your hospital badge when signing up in person.

name: Basecamp Strength Studio
blurb: 25% off month-to-month membership dues.
details: Applies only to month-to-month memberships; does not apply to annual contracts, class packs, or personal training add-ons.
redeem: Mention the hospital partner program when you sign up.

name: Wellness Healthplex
blurb: $20/month membership with a one-time $35 enrollment fee.
details: Includes pool access, group fitness classes, and locker rooms. A family add-on is available for an extra $10/month per person.
redeem: Enroll at the front desk with your staff badge.

name: BloomExpress Flowers
blurb: 15% off all flower and gift purchases.
details: Enter the discount code online at checkout, or mention it in-store. Excludes wedding packages and large event orders.
redeem: Use code CORPSHOP online or in-store.

name: Main Lobby Gift Shop
blurb: 10% off regular-priced cards, gifts, and sundries.
details: Discount applies to regular-priced merchandise only and cannot be combined with items already marked down or on clearance.
redeem: Show your badge at checkout.

name: Bliss Massage Therapy
blurb: $10 off any massage therapy session.
details: Valid for hospital staff and immediate family members. Book online or call ahead and mention the employee discount.
redeem: Mention the discount when booking your appointment.

name: Reliable Roofing & Home Repair
blurb: $50 off repairs over $250; up to $750 off a full roof replacement.
details: Includes a free inspection and written quote. Financing options are available for larger projects.
redeem: Call and mention the hospital employee program.

name: Summit Moving & Storage
blurb: Discounted corporate moving and storage rates.
details: Rate includes packing materials and short-term storage options. Long-distance moves are quoted separately.
redeem: Reference the hospital partner code when requesting a quote.

name: Horizon Wireless
blurb: $10 off per line on unlimited plans.
details: Discount applies automatically once your employer email is verified in-store or online. May be combined with select carrier promotions.
redeem: Verify your employment in-store or through the online portal.

name: TravelSaver Hotels
blurb: Up to 40% off select hotels worldwide.
details: Participating properties are listed on the employee travel portal and are updated weekly. Rates vary by location and season.
redeem: Book through the employee travel portal link.

name: DriveEasy Car Rental
blurb: Save up to 25% on every rental.
details: Discount applies to the base rental rate and can be applied when booking online or by phone.
redeem: Enter the corporate discount code at booking.

name: QuickLube Auto Service
blurb: 15% off oil changes and vehicle inspections.
details: Applies to standard maintenance services. Does not cover parts replacement over $100 or major repairs.
redeem: Show your badge at drop-off.

name: TechHub Computers
blurb: 10% off laptops, desktops, and accessories.
details: Discount applies to most in-stock items. Excludes clearance items, pre-orders, and extended warranty plans.
redeem: Use the employee portal link for online orders, or show your badge in-store.

name: Handy Hardware Co.
blurb: $5 off purchases of $50 or more.
details: Valid on in-store purchases only. Cannot be combined with other sales, coupons, or promotions.
redeem: Show your badge at checkout.

name: Parkview Apartments
blurb: Waived application fee plus $200 off your first month.
details: Available to full-time hospital staff on approved 12-month leases. Availability varies — contact the leasing office to confirm current openings.
redeem: Mention the hospital partner program when you apply.

name: ColorCraft Paints
blurb: 20% off interior and exterior paint.
details: Discount applies to paint products only, not tools, brushes, or supplies. Valid at all regional locations.
redeem: Show your badge at the register.

name: Chipotle
blurb: $3 off any burrito or bowl.
details: Discount applies to any bowl size, any day of the week. Catering orders of $50 or more also qualify for 10% off — ask a manager for the catering menu.
redeem: Show your hospital ID badge at checkout.
